📺 East Los High (2013–2017)

East Los High follows a group of teenagers attending high school in East Los Angeles as they navigate complicated relationships, friendships, family expectations, and the challenges of growing up. The story centers on students like Jessie, Maya, Jacob, and Vanessa, whose lives become intertwined through romance, secrets, jealousy, and personal struggles. From intense love triangles and heartbreak to dance competitions, family conflicts, and unexpected betrayals, the students face difficult decisions that could change their futures. Set against the vibrant culture of East Los Angeles, the series explores the emotional realities of teenage life while highlighting the importance of friendship, family, and cultural identity. Featuring a talented Latino ensemble cast, the show delivers heartfelt moments, dramatic twists, and unforgettable relationships while exploring love, loyalty, ambition, acceptance, and the challenges of finding your place in the world.

🎭 Genre: Teen Drama • Romance • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 6.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22–30 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Carlos Portugal & Kathleen Bedoya

📺 Seasons: 4

📚 Setting: East Los Angeles, California
